title: Attendance Shortage

examples.explanation: 75% of 40 classes is 30. Student 1 attended exactly 30, which is enough. Students 2 and 4 are short.

hints: Student i is short when aᵢ / T < 0.75. Floating-point division can round the wrong way right at the boundary. Can you compare with integers only?
Multiply both sides by 100 · T: the student is short exactly when 100 · aᵢ < 75 · T. With T up to 10⁹, those products need 64 bits.
Collect the short students in order and print them space-separated, or -1 if the list is empty.
